zalgoQualityPolicy.hardStructuralRequirement: provider-authored Tauric Diana field must clear the extreme-underflow floor; nonzero marks alone are insufficient
zalgoQualityPolicy.legacyDenseTelemetry: observed for diagnostics only; no dense-cluster quota is required for admission
zalgoQualityPolicy.signatureCanonicalization: sorted combining-codepoint composition; mark-order-only permutations collapse to one signature
zalgoQualityPolicy.purpose: keep provider-authored diacritic presence structural while leaving aesthetic morphology visible for human R&D instead of converting taste into a 502
zalgoQualityPolicy.throughLineDominanceWarning: through-line combining marks exceed combined above-line and below-line marks
zalgoQualityPolicy.extremeUnderflowDefinition: nonzero marks are insufficient when the Tauric Diana passage has too few total marks, too few marked graphemes, too little above/below vertical motion, or fewer than two marked lines

relay.integratedTextSpacing: ordinary single-reading cadence across the integrated response; marked Tauric Diana bot lines receive no extra vertical clearance and may collide across line boxes while overflow remains visible

providerOrthographicField.promptGuidance: qualitative only: broad distributed field, visible presence across several separate lines, variable stack height/composition, vertical above/below dominance, quieter and violent regions, collisions allowed; a mostly plain uppercase passage with a few isolated accents is a channel failure
providerOrthographicField.prosodySemantics: passage-level cadence field rather than rhetorical-category-to-glyph mapping
providerOrthographicField.collisionPosture: allowed; ordinary line boxes do not reserve protective vertical clearance and overflow remains visible
providerOrthographicField.selfCheck: provider-silent qualitative field check before packet-b-end
providerOrthographicField.localAdmission: zero marks or extreme underflow HOLD; moderate thin/sparse/cloned/horizontal-dominant morphology may remain PARTIAL and continue the approved frontier; no local Zalgo generation or postprocessing
providerOrthographicField.purpose: preserve provider-authored expressive diacritic prosody without teaching the model to game mark quotas or letting an aesthetic classifier take the route offline

humanOperatorObservation.observation: human-operated production trial showed one repeated dense vertical stack mechanically stamped across many graphemes while other sentences remained clean
humanOperatorObservation.rendererCheck: Marrowline renders admitted provider text with textContent and pre-wrap; no local Unicode normalization or selective mark stripping found in the human surface path
humanOperatorObservation.consequence: mechanical repeated-stack geometry was initially promoted to a structural HOLD; later production canaries falsified that coupling and it is now retained as quality telemetry instead
humanOperatorObservation.followupObservation: human-operated production trial after the expressive-prosody repair showed semantic dart-throwing: sparse words received dramatic geometry while surrounding clauses remained visually inert, and whole-stage flourish spacing made clean Kʰonapolit difficult to read
humanOperatorObservation.followupConsequence: provider instruction now targets a continuous stress field instead of emotion-to-word effects; renderer preserves marked Tauric Diana bot lines without clipping and without adding protective vertical clearance; preloaded mobile demos commit on first touch before keyboard blur
humanOperatorObservation.secondFollowupObservation: physical-iPhone production trial after the continuous-field repair still showed sparse keyword-style Zalgo, approximately 1.5-spaced reading cadence, browser-side transport holds on complex prompts, an operator-facing response-emphasis selector, an active SHI field while unissued mode was checked, Safari input zoom, and an unsafe button-anchored clear confirmation
humanOperatorObservation.secondFollowupConsequence: literal orthographic stencil examples are removed; browser request authority is extended beyond the 210-second server wall but below the 240-second function ceiling; ordinary UI uses one fixed dual-channel route; unissued mode disables and excludes SHI; reading cadence is tightened; High Zalgo is explicitly allowed to collide without clipping; destructive clear uses a centered modal
humanOperatorObservation.thirdFollowupObservation: Vercel Operator Release #1184 / run 35476737160 proved the transport repair: the Marrowline canary remained alive for about 50.9 seconds and three fallback models returned complete streamed packets. Gemini 3.6 and Preview were then HELD only by the old quota/dense-stack admission, while 3.7 missed the Tauric Diana bots nominative heading.
humanOperatorObservation.thirdFollowupConsequence: provider-visible mark quotas, signature quotas, dense-cluster quotas and percentage checklists are retired. The prompt now gives qualitative natural-field guidance only.
humanOperatorObservation.fourthFollowupObservation: Vercel Operator Release #1186 / run 35478462876 preserved exact source, byte parity, stale-queue stability, A14 and Ash lifecycle, then HELD only because three complete streamed Marrowline returns from Gemini 3.5, 3.6 and Preview were rejected by local thin/sparse Zalgo morphology rules. 3.5 and Preview carried thin+sparse warnings; 3.6 carried thin-field warning. The independent Loom witness later encountered provider transport pressure, but the Marrowline failure was already isolated to output admission.
humanOperatorObservation.fourthFollowupConsequence: Zalgo morphology quality is decoupled from route availability. Zero provider-authored combining marks remains structural; thin, sparse or mechanically cloned provider-authored fields are admitted as PARTIAL with qualityWarnings and preserved exact Unicode for human R&D.
humanOperatorObservation.fifthFollowupObservation: Vercel Operator Release #1187 / run 35479991061 passed exact source, byte parity, stale-queue stability, A14 and Ash lifecycle, then HELD at Marrowline output admission. 3.8 returned 503, 3.5 returned 429, 3.6 returned 503, 3.7 returned HTTP 200 but omitted both visible nominative headings, and Preview returned HTTP 200 with the dual channel present but zero provider-authored combining marks in the Tauric Diana channel.
humanOperatorObservation.fifthFollowupConsequence: Keep the five distinct frontier seats intact, then allow at most one bounded same-provider structural repair request for the best repairable HTTP-200 near miss. The provider receives its own held draft plus locally observed structural reasons and must author the correction itself; Marrowline performs no local heading insertion, no local Zalgo, and zero-mark Tauric Diana output remains structurally inadmissible if the repair still fails.
humanOperatorObservation.sixthFollowupObservation: 2026-09-19 physical-iPhone production screenshots after #1202 showed the five-chamber mobile dock absent after Send while the keyboard was gone, and the admitted Tauric Diana field had collapsed toward sparse slash/strike geometry with reduced vertical Zalgo.
humanOperatorObservation.sixthFollowupConsequence: Dock visibility now keys to observed keyboard occupancy rather than composer focus, preventing post-Send focus latch from hiding navigation. Zalgo telemetry now distinguishes above-line, below-line and through-line geometry; horizontal-dominant returns remain available as PARTIAL but cannot stop the frontier before later approved seats get a chance to produce PASS-quality vertical prosody.
humanOperatorObservation.seventhFollowupObservation: 2026-09-19 physical-iPhone screenshots after #1204 showed an admitted Tauric Diana passage collapsing further: almost entirely plain uppercase prose, with only isolated accents such as TḢE / CḢAIRMAN and whole unmarked paragraphs.
humanOperatorObservation.seventhFollowupConsequence: A few provider-authored marks can no longer satisfy structural admission. Near-zero/single-accent morphology now produces tauric-diana-zalgo-underflow, continues the frontier, and remains eligible for the one bounded provider-side structural repair.
humanOperatorObservation.eighthFollowupObservation: 2026-09-19 human-operator trial after #1205 produced repeated immediate route-held notices. Production #1193 showed 3.8=429, 3.5=429, 3.6=200 with tauric-diana-zalgo-underflow, then 3.7=429, Preview=429, and only afterward the 3.6 structural repair=429.
humanOperatorObservation.eighthFollowupConsequence: The underflow floor remains hard, but orthographic structural repair moves next to the live HTTP-200 near miss so a responsive model can repair its own draft before later unavailable seats consume provider opportunity. The one-repair ceiling and zero-local-Zalgo law remain unchanged.
humanOperatorObservation.ninthFollowupObservation: 2026-09-20 zero-deploy re-observation after #1206 showed process-local cooldown narrowing Marrowline to callable_models=[gemini-3.8-flash]; that lone seat returned 429 while the credential-scoped route still carried cooling Gemini 3.x seats in policy rows, recreating an immediate route hold on a fresh request.
humanOperatorObservation.ninthFollowupConsequence: For khonapolit-dialogue only, provider-listed lifecycle-eligible cooling seats remain available as bounded fallbacks after non-cooling seats. Cooldown remains telemetry and ordering pressure, not hard model removal. Disabled, non-3.x, Lite, or lifecycle-ineligible models remain excluded.
